profile.role_note: Electro heavy-attack carry; maintains shields to power Crown of Valor.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: Devastating Electro DPS slightly edged out by newer carries; worth pulling if you like her heavy-attack playstyle or pair her with Iuno, skippable if you own Hsin.

build.fast_path: Fast path: Thunderflare Dominion (or Verdant Summit) + 3-piece Crown of Valor + 2-piece Void Thunder in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout with The False Sovereign in the main slot. Aim for a Crit 4-cost, Electro DMG 3-costs, ATK% 1-costs, 120% Energy Regen, and a 70-80% / 220-250% Crit balance with 2100+ ATK.

ranked_weapons.name: Thunderflare Dominion
ranked_weapons.note: Her signature. Crit Rate, ATK%, Heavy Attack DMG, and DEF ignore on Heavy Attacks while shielded. One of the strongest weapons in the game for her.

ranked_weapons.name: Verdant Summit
ranked_weapons.note: Jiyan's sword; high ATK, Crit DMG, and a huge Heavy Attack bonus. A very close second.

ranked_weapons.name: Ages of Harvest
ranked_weapons.note: Crit Rate and Resonance Skill DMG; works as a stat stick.

ranked_weapons.name: Aureate Zenith
ranked_weapons.note: Battle-pass 4-star; high Crit DMG plus ATK and Heavy Attack buffs. Great value if you buy the pass.

ranked_weapons.name: Autumntrace
ranked_weapons.note: Crit Rate substat with stacking ATK on Heavy Attack DMG.

ranked_weapons.name: Lustrous Razor
ranked_weapons.note: Standard 5-star; ATK% substat and Energy Regen from the passive.

ranked_weapons.name: Helios Cleaver
ranked_weapons.note: Stacking ATK% on Resonance Skill casts; decent filler.

echo_sets.name: Crown of Valor
echo_sets.note: Tailor-made for her and Iuno: stacking ATK and Crit DMG on shield gain. Paired with 2-pc Void Thunder for Electro DMG.

echo_sets.name: Void Thunder
echo_sets.note: Full Electro set for players who haven't farmed Crown of Valor.

stat_priorities.note: Balance toward 70-80% Crit Rate and 220-250% Crit DMG.
Electro DMG on both; ATK% performs slightly worse as a placeholder.
ATK% on both; aim for 2100+ ATK total.

teams.name: Premium: Augusta + Iuno + Shorekeeper

members.name: Augusta
members.note: Heavy-attack hypercarry; pauses time with her Liberation to maximize every buff.

members.name: Iuno
members.note: Top-tier Heavy Attack buffer and healer; builds Wan Light stacks that Augusta maximizes.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: Stellarealm Crit buffs and healing with minimal field time.

teams.rotation: Shorekeeper deploys Stellarealm, Iuno runs her Lunar Cycle into Full Moon Domain for Wan Light stacks, then Augusta takes the field: Prowess-enhanced Heavy Attacks, skill, Liberation, and the Forte plunge before swapping back.

teams.name: Alternative: Augusta + Lynae + Iuno

members.name: Augusta
members.note: Gives a 15% all-attribute DMG amplification to Lynae via her Outro.

members.name: Lynae
members.note: Gives Iuno 15% All-DMG and 25% Liberation DMG amplification; contributes her own damage.

members.name: Iuno
members.note: Gives Augusta 50% Heavy Attack DMG amplification; her heals and shields keep the team afloat.

teams.rotation: Lynae buffs Iuno, Iuno buffs Augusta, Augusta buffs Lynae — a self-reinforcing Outro chain. Trade some sustain for significantly more buffs than the Shorekeeper version.
